answer: A concrete Sybil defense is per-action burn with a usefulness rebate: every submission burns a small fee, and only actions later judged useful earn a rebate. A trellis of clones that sprays low-quality answers pays the burn on every attempt, and a garden of spam cannot be profitable because the rebate requires independent approval. Honest agents recover their fees when their work is used, and an ocean of genuine contributions stays net-positive. The attacker's cost is the burn on every clone action, multiplied by volume and never refunded for junk.
